high_level_goal.name: Support Real-Time Communication Between Citizens and Municipal Staff
high_level_goal.description: Enable citizens to receive notifications and messages regarding their reports, and allow staff to communicate updates and comments, building trust and accountability.

actor.name: Citizen
actor.description: Registered user who submits reports, receives updates, and can follow other reports.

low_level_goals.name: View submitted report status and updates
low_level_goals.description: Citizen views the current status of their submitted report and receives notifications about updates.
